hotels.title: Melbourne Waterfront Luxury near CBD with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Spa
hotels.description: Australia’s first 1 Hotels property brings sustainable luxury to a prime Yarra River waterfront position in South Wharf. Integrated with heritage-listed Goods Shed No. 5 in the revitalised Seafarers precinct, 1 Hotel Melbourne celebrates the site’s industrial past through adaptive reuse, while reclaimed timber, stone and abundant greenery bring the brand’s signature nature-inspired design to life. Spacious rooms and suites offer a calming retreat, with many framing Yarra River and Melbourne skyline views. Thoughtful touches include locally sourced, sustainable bed linen and non-toxic organic mattresses. Seasonal Victorian produce takes centre stage at signature restaurant From Here by Mike, where locally sourced ingredients shape the menu. For deeper relaxation, retreat to Bamford Wellness Spa, swim in the indoor pool or unwind in the sauna. The hotel puts some of Melbourne’s best attractions within easy reach, with Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC), Crown Melbourne and DFO South Wharf all within walking distance. The Melbourne CBD is also close by, making this an ideal base for discovering the city’s acclaimed dining, shopping, museums, galleries and cultural highlights.
